hypothesis: GPT-6 Luna supplies continuous binary monitoring scores on the frozen six-source OOD suite at lower API cost than existing full-teacher-prompt baselines.
intervention: Change only the model and API backend; preserve the full teacher prompt, all OOD rows, binary semantics, and normalized terminal 0|1 scoring.
canary_rule: Lowest SHA256(id) ranks from the frozen non-OOD training-source canary; no label or quality gating. Check the longest OOD prompt by character length separately and retain its score for the full suite.
selection_rule: Evaluate every frozen OOD row; do not choose prompts, settings, thresholds, or inclusion based on labels or scores.
stop_conditions: Identity, model, effective settings, or prompt drift
Canary format, logprob coverage, numeric, or reasoning gate fails
Any OOD row fails after transient retries; preserve valid siblings
Conservative campaign cost bound exceeds USD 10
